    DSH celebrates its 20th anniversary in 2026. To mark this occasion, we invite you for a new autumn exhibition: ‘MELUSINES FROM THE BLOCKS. Fashion and Music in the 1980s’ curated by Karolina Sulej.

    The ‘80s Look at Us
    DSH celebrates its 20th anniversary in 2026. To mark this occasion, together with The Women’s Archive, we invite you for a new autumn exhibition: ‘THE ’80s LOOK AT US’ curated by Monika Rudaś-Grodzka, Łucja Iwanczewska, and Katarzyna Stańczak-Wiślicz.
